title: Eat and Learn
description: The foodie researcher Jafar is still studying "eating" today...

mainQuestExcel.title: Eat and Learn
mainQuestExcel.description: The foodie researcher Jafar is still studying "eating" today...

dialogs.text: You seem to be in a rush, my friend. What's bothering you?
Lots of things...
Ah... Indeed, I can see that you are tired and pressed for time.
You must have something on your mind that needs to be resolved as soon as possible.
Rather than rushing about, I'd like to invite you to have a delicious meal with me if you are willing to wait but a little while.
Haste is indeed a normal part of life, yes... but as we often put it, even a raging river must sometimes flow peacefully through a serene stream.
You must take a little break every now and then.
Hmmm...
Why don't we enjoy some Minty Bean Soup together?
You don't have to pay me any Mora. Just help me find a sprig of Mint.
Ah, yes — and don't be too picky when you search for that mint sprig.
Remember, you are just looking for a regular sprig. You aren't looking for troubles of any kind.
I'm alright, actually.
Oh, that's good, that's good.
Still, your steps are hurried. You seek to fix some problem or another, perhaps?
Well, I don't know what problem it is that you seek to solve, but I have a suggestion...

flow.stepDescription: Give the cooking ingredient to Jafar

dialogs.text: Please find me <color=#00E1FFFF>a sprig of Mint</color>.
That is an excellent sprig of Mint, indeed! Now, please wait here a while.
Jafar has the ingredients ready and starts cooking...
This is the Minty Bean Soup, made with the ingredients you brought. Please help yourself.
Thank you.
My pleasure. Enjoy your meal!
To me, eating means leaving all my exhausting work and research behind for a time...
I let my mind flow peacefully through that serene stream... this is how I relax.
Well, enjoy your meal to the fullest. I hope that it can also put your mind at ease.
